verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own DGX B300 documentation states the system runs DGX OS 7, which is based on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, with additional support for Ubuntu, RHEL 8/9 and Rocky Linux. That shows first-party Linux OS support for the platform. However, no evidence covers Linux driver release documentation, and nothing shows independent Linux testing of the B300. Missing for 10: documented Linux driver releases/release notes for B300, independent or hands-on Linux testing of the part.

support.subject: As a developer, Linux is a first-class citizen for this GPU — documented Linux driver releases and independent Linux testing of this part

citations.quote: DGX OS 7 based on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; Additional support for Ubuntu and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and 9, Rocky Linux
